market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool have finished top 4 in seven of the last eight Premier League seasons and, under Arne Slot, are leading the 2024–25 campaign. Their squad depth, financial power and consistently high performance level suggest a ≥70% chance of making the top 4 in 2025–26, while the market implies only ~52.5%. Although the season is not yet begun, Liverpool's track record makes the 'Yes' significantly mispriced.
evidence_points: 7 top-4 finishes in last 8 EPL seasons (only miss was 2022–23 in 5th)
Currently leading the 2024–25 EPL under Slot with strong underlying metrics
Squad includes world-class players (Salah, Van Dijk, Alisson) and stable management
sources_consulted: General football knowledge of Liverpool’s 2024–25 performance
